real_data.source: Crustdata live API, fake model (no model calls), neatlogs tracing off, same records for both pipelines
real_data.slice: Staffing and Recruiting, India, 11-50 and 51-200 employees, first 10 by company id ascending (6779 companies match the filters)
real_data.caveat: Flagged by a zero-tolerance rule (headcount outside the stated size band by any amount). The magnitude of the mismatches has not been analysed, so this is a rule outcome, not proof that the data is wrong.

real_data_real_model.source: Crustdata live API and the real model (claude-haiku through the hackathon gateway), neatlogs tracing off, same records for both pipelines, company ids ascending
real_data_real_model.slice: Staffing and Recruiting, India, 11-50 and 51-200 employees, first 10 by company id ascending (6779 companies match the filters)
real_data_real_model.privacy: Real company profiles were sent to the model gateway in these runs. No company record is stored in the repository, in the run reports or in any trace.
notes: One run per pipeline on 10 live records, so this is a small sample, not a benchmark.
The same three companies were flagged in both runs by a zero-tolerance size rule whose magnitude was not analysed (see real_data.caveat).
Cited but not citeable means the model cited a fact id that is not one of our fact ids for that company; it can mean an invented field or a different field name.
Per assessment the improved prompt costs more; the total is lower because only enriched companies are assessed.
